Link WhatsApp

Connects the Zoorzio number that your subscribers message.
Admin sign-in required.

Checking…

Press “Start pairing” to generate a QR code.

  1. On the phone holding the Zoorzio number, open WhatsApp.
  2. Go to Settings → Linked devices.
  3. Tap Link a device and scan the code above.

The QR rotates every few seconds while pairing — this page refreshes it automatically, so scan whichever code is on screen. The session is stored encrypted in the database, so this only needs doing once, not on every deploy.
